title: Event envelope
description: What every message on the event bus looks like. The payload is described by the schema for the topic, at the given schema version.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event; consumers deduplicate on it.

topic.description: Topic name, object.verb in the past tense; also the Kafka topic.

schema_version.description: Version of the payload schema for this topic.

occurred_at.description: When the event happened, with a UTC offset.

tenant_id.description: The tenant the event belongs to; null for regulatory events.

correlation_id.description: Ties together everything one request or workflow caused.

causation_id.description: The event_id this event was a direct reaction to; null at the start of a chain.

payload.description: Topic-specific fields; see the topic's schema.
